reason: My bookkeeper and I already run everything through Zoho Expense and it works well enough. Pulling receipts out of the Telegram groups is annoying, but not annoying enough to move our books into a Google Sheet run by a bot I've never heard of.
objection: Who is behind this, and will it still be running in a year? If a small bot shuts down or gets abandoned, my staff have changed how they send receipts and I'm left cleaning up the mess in the middle of a project.
would_change_my_mind: If it pushed the receipts from our Telegram groups straight into Zoho or Jurnal instead of a separate Google Sheet, and there was a real company with a track record behind it, I'd try it on one site.
